scope: AMD64/QEMU developer application environment on Flex; selected x86_64-linux-musl workloads
api_boundary: Runs as a Flex application, using native namespace/resource grants; Linux syscall ABI is implemented by the environment.

phases.title: Scope, audit and repeatable baseline
exit_criteria: Audited main and all cumulative PR heads
Versioned targets and finite acceptance gates committed
Existing baseline rerun with pinned fixtures in CI

phases.title: Filesystem environment and live resource mounts
exit_criteria: Root tree and explicit mount grants
POSIX path/metadata operations required by target apps
Persistent changes, revocation, limits and namespace isolation

phases.title: Memory, process and resource compatibility
exit_criteria: Mutable-file private COW and shared anonymous mappings
Required shared futex/process/session/resource APIs
Measured developer resource profile with aggregate quotas

phases.title: AMD64 instruction, loader and library coverage
exit_criteria: Named target executables and libraries load
Required integer, floating point and baseline SIMD semantics
Unsupported operations fail explicitly; differential failures resolved

phases.title: Networking and guest TLS applications
exit_criteria: DNS, UDP, IPv6 and target-required stream APIs
Exact resource grants, concurrent connections and deadlines
Guest HTTPS hostname/certificate checks with real separate peers

phases.title: Interactive terminal and job control
exit_criteria: PTY, termios and terminal input/output
Foreground/background groups, signals and terminal resize
Target-required proc/dev interfaces

phases.title: Unmodified application and developer workflow qualification
exit_criteria: Pinned BusyBox, CPython, Git and C toolchain workflows all pass
Source/dependency/build-config/binary locks complete
Finite measured budgets and native evidence for every gate

phases.title: Reviewed integration and developer release candidate
exit_criteria: Clean boot/install/recovery instructions reproduced
All baseline/native/security gates green at exact final source
Separate user authorization before merge; inherited publication gates retained

targets.name: BusyBox
workflows: Shell script with pipelines, substitutions and file operations
Interactive ash job control through a PTY
targets.build_configuration: Version-identical unmodified source; explicit applet and ash job-control config. Existing published binary remains the regression fixture.

targets.name: CPython
workflows: Run a multi-module stdlib project using json/pathlib/tempfile
Thread/process/subprocess round trips and module imports
Authorized DNS/socket/ssl exchange with positive and negative certificate tests

targets.name: Git
workflows: Clone/fetch/push a disposable repository over granted HTTPS
Reject an untrusted certificate and an ungranted destination
targets.build_configuration: C command-line tools with HTTPS remote helpers; GUI/Tcl/Perl integrations are outside v1.

targets.name: GNU GCC
workflows: Compile multi-file C with musl headers/libraries
Build pthread/file/socket examples and execute their produced ELF in the guest
Build and load a small shared library
targets.build_configuration: C language, x86-64 baseline/SSE2, generic tuning, no AVX requirement; no C++/Fortran/Go claim.

targets.name: GNU Binutils
workflows: Assemble/link C build outputs; inspect ELF/symbols with readelf/nm

targets.name: GNU Make
workflows: Clean build and incremental rebuild of the C project using guest processes

targets.name: musl libc
workflows: Dynamic/static target application startup, TLS, stdio, allocation and pthread behavior

requirements.acceptance: Mount a declared root with /etc,/home,/usr,/var and /tmp; create, edit, rename, enumerate and reload a project tree.
requirements.progress: Qualified bounded managed-root/live-directory profile: root/project operations, view inheritance and monotonic revocation, traversal/link denial, restart and completed-write recovery. Native mount/POSIX limits remain explicit.

requirements.acceptance: Application and environment namespace views enforce grants; traversal, symlink and hardlink attempts cannot reach an ungranted host resource.
requirements.progress: Qualified bounded managed-root/live-directory profile: root/project operations, view inheritance and monotonic revocation, traversal/link denial, restart and completed-write recovery. Native mount/POSIX limits remain explicit.

requirements.acceptance: Changes survive an independent environment restart; denied writes and failed imports do not overwrite existing output; recovery behavior is documented.
requirements.progress: Qualified bounded managed-root/live-directory profile: root/project operations, view inheritance and monotonic revocation, traversal/link denial, restart and completed-write recovery. Native mount/POSIX limits remain explicit.

requirements.acceptance: Private COW, shared anonymous maps, shared futex and required process/session calls pass Linux references, failure and lifetime tests.
requirements.progress: 3A merged; shared anonymous/futex keys and declared session/limit APIs implemented; exact-head qualification in associated PR, wider required-call discovery remains open

requirements.acceptance: Every target has explicit measured image/memory/steps/time/fd/filesystem/network budgets and aggregate enforcement; no unlimited default.
requirements.progress: Aggregate arena cap and fixture peak measurements implemented; all seven named-target image/RAM/steps/time/fd/storage/network qualification remains pending; five targets lack locked runnable artifacts

requirements.acceptance: Target-required instructions, floating point/SIMD, loader/TLS and libraries pass differential checks and native execution.
Real separate-node DNS, IPv4/IPv6 TCP and UDP exchanges pass; denial, disconnect, exhaustion and deadline tests pass.
Unmodified guest TLS libraries validate certificates/hostnames; bad trust and ungranted routes fail without host-side application substitution.
Interactive PTY shell handles input, Ctrl-C, resize, foreground/background jobs and cleanup.
All declared BusyBox scripts/applets and interactive workflow complete with expected files, output and exit statuses.
The declared stdlib project, process/thread/subprocess and TLS workflows run on the native Flex guest.
Local and granted HTTPS clone/fetch/commit/push workflows persist and produce matching repository content.
Guest GCC/binutils/make build the C project and shared library; resulting ELF executes in the same environment with expected behavior.
Source checksums, complete transitive dependencies, build configs/tool versions and final binary hashes are pinned and recorded.
requirements.progress: Seven pinned release ELF hashes matched on two independent GitHub Actions runs; exact-head artifact and source-lock checking required; app/native V1 qualification separately open

requirements.acceptance: Exact source, fixture hashes, source challenges, genuine results and independent compiled/installed/extracted kernel provenance are recorded with no skipped required workloads.
A fresh AMD64 QEMU boot follows documented install/launch/export/recovery commands and reproduces all acceptance workflows.
Final source passes inherited baseline/security/driver/native checks; cumulative history reviewed and merge separately authorized; publication remains subject to existing release policy.

excluded_from_v1: GUI/desktop, GPU, audio and device application stacks
C++ and other GCC language frontends
Arbitrary pip packages and binary wheels
Operational ARM64 and physical hardware qualification
Automatic merge or public kernel binary publication
change_control: Target/version/scope changes require a reviewed plan revision and preserved evidence; no silent replacement of CPython/GCC with smaller substitutes. Published archive selection is a fixed compatibility reference, not a claim of latest upstream versions.
